ops.title: Regenerate map/ and confirm the delta is bounded
ops.imperative: Regenerate the derived code map with `py -m scripts.code_map build --root .` inside the real worktree (the builder shells out to `git ls-files`, so a git-archive export cannot answer this). NEVER hand-edit map/INDEX.md. Then confirm the actual delta matches the shape attempt 1 predicted to a scratch --out: 9 hunks, all entity counts plus one new module row (scripts 1211->1213; tests 82 modules/4725 -> 83 modules/4736; scripts.hooks 84->85; scripts.hooks.spine_rail 62->63; scripts.checklist_engine 110->111; tests.test_spine_rail 187->189 with 96->95 holes; + tests.test_worktree_derivation). Call out BY NAME any hunk that does not match that shape -- a rebuild that rewrites more than entity counts and the one new row is a signal, not a formality, and is a stop condition. Finally run the targeted gate check.

preconditions.statement: map/ is in allowed scope for this attempt (rework handoff grants it explicitly, citing the launch order)

postconditions.statement: map freshness and the targeted gate check both pass
